newsitem.title: UK: OPEC members say March output 25.45 mbpd.
newsitem.headline: OPEC members say March output 25.45 mbpd.

text.p: OPEC pumped 25.45 million barrels a day (bpd) of crude in March, up from 25.33 million bpd in February, according to member country submissions, OPEC headquarters said on Friday.
OPEC supply to the market in March was 25.38 million bpd from 25.21 million bpd, OPEC news agency said in a monthly report from the group's Vienna secretariat.
By comparison, a Reuters survey, one of four used by OPEC to monitor its members' production trends put March output at 26.9 million bpd from 26.77 million in February.
The OPEC secretariat said it had revised down its estimate for 1997 world oil demand by 30,000 bpd to 70.86 million.
It left unchanged its projection for the call on OPEC crude this year at 25.30 million.
